messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER: latency SLO breach on /v1/generate (p95 > 800ms) detected in us-west-2. Likely customer impact. Paging oncall.
Morgan (oncall): acked, jumping in. Pulling dashboards.
Morgan (oncall): grafana -> https://grafana.company/internal/d/abcd/runtime-latency?orgId=1 — p95 spike at ~03:12 UTC, increased kernel_fallback metric on canary hosts.
Carla (SRE): grabbing pod logs and metrics now. Any recent deploys?
DeployBot: deploy complete: runtime-service v2.14 -> canary 10% at 03:08 UTC by @Brian K.
Dave (runtime): I see batch queue length rising and kernel_fallbacks correlated with seq_len>2048 traces. New kernel-affinity selector in v2.14 looks suspicious.
Brian K (deploy): orchestration paused further rollout after health checks failed on canaries at 10% :warning:.
Morgan (oncall): copy of relevant log tail:
```
[2026-03-16T03:12:09Z] runtime: kernel_fallback=true model=rwkv-2 seq_len=4096 latency=912ms batch_size=8
[2026-03-16T03:12:11Z] runtime: kv_cache_miss=0.02 prefetch_delay=120ms
[2026-03-16T03:12:12Z] healthcheck: failed probe=slow_response
```

Alice M (support): two paying customers reported slow responses during that window. CS alerted.
Theo (CS): ABC-Infra (high qps long-context) saw timeouts; they want an update.
Dave (runtime): recommended immediate mitigation: flip feature kill-switch for kernel-affinity and revert selector to stable path.
Brian K (deploy): running emergency rollback on canary to v2.13 and pausing rollout.
DeployBot: rollback job initiated by @Brian K — `deployctl rollback runtime-service v2.13 --scope canary --reason "kernel-affinity regression"`.
Morgan (oncall): putting temporary route fallback for VIP customers to lower-latency dedicated pool.
Carla (SRE): applying short-term batching cap to reduce batch-induced tail latency. Patch commands:
```
kubectl -n runtime set env deploy/runtime-service BATCH_MAX_SIZE=4
kubectl -n runtime patch hpa runtime-service --patch '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":50}}'
```
IncidentBot: rollback to v2.13 succeeded on canary at 03:26 UTC. Observability: p95 trending down but still above baseline for long-context cases.
Morgan (oncall): kernel_fallback counts decreasing; throughput recovering. Continuing monitoring.
Dave (runtime): bisect points to commit 9f3b2f which changed kernel heuristic to prefer tiled kernels when seq_len>1024. Reverting heuristic in hotfix branch.
Alice M (support): ABC-Infra and DeltaApps confirm response times improving. No errors or data loss reported.
Theo (CS): opening customer comms: provide timeline + RCA for ABC-Infra compliance team.
Brian K (deploy): marking P1 and preparing incident timeline for postmortem. I'll capture deploy/rollback timestamps and commit refs.
Morgan (oncall): handing off to @Dave (runtime) for root-cause and remediation. Dave will be primary for next shift window. Handoff notes: rollback done, kill-switch used, batching cap applied, VIP route fallback enabled.
Dave (runtime): ack. Will open postmortem ticket and a fix PR. Plan: revert selector heuristics, add seq-length synthetic checks to canary gating, and staged rollout with stricter health probes. ETA 6h for fix validation and re-rollout.
Carla (SRE): updating runbook to include sequence-length synthetic traffic in rollout smoke tests and an automated gating rule for kernel_fallback metric.
SupportBot: impacted customers: [ABC-Infra, DeltaApps]. CS owners: @Theo. Recommended status page message: "Degraded latency for long-context workloads in us-west-2 during canary rollout; rollback applied and fixes in progress."
Morgan (oncall): concise summary for rotation: 1) v2.14 canary caused kernel selector regression for long contexts; 2) rollback to v2.13 performed; 3) kill-switch and batching cap applied; 4) VIP route fallback enabled; 5) follow-ups: revert heuristics, add seq-len gating, customer comms, postmortem.
Dave (runtime): creating Jira INF-4521: "kernel-selector regression: revert heuristics + add sequence-length canary gating" and linking incident.
Morgan (oncall): handoff complete :white_check_mark: Monitoring to continue until full recovery.
SupportBot: Incident closed for paging but ticket remains open for RCA and rollout policy changes.
